title: Universal exact rational maximal-minor formula for every finite subset-action (n,k)
status: Traditional mathematical proof completed; exhaustive integer checks and initial Lean kernel lemma available. Whole theorem NOT Lean-formalized or externally peer-reviewed.
theorems: All n>=1 and 0<=k<=n: exact finite maximum of rational alternating maximal-minor ratios; complement symmetry and trivial-action boundaries included.
Full orbital matrix rank m+1 with determinant (-1)^m product_{r=0}^{m-1} binom(n-2r,m-r), m=min(k,n-k)>=1.
Any positive optimum attained by at most m+2 signed conjugacy-class profiles; this uniform support bound is sharp at n=11,k=4.
Generalization to any finite permutation group action through conjugacy-class/orbital integer matrices and row rank rho.

independent_replays.integer: 15 exact historical value comparisons and m=1..9 nonzero rank determinant; n=9 k=4 tested all 118755 candidate matrices
independent_replays.generic: 214 full-row-rank rational matrix kernel-circuit comparisons against independent SymPy nullspace enumeration
independent_replays.sharp_sparse: S11 four-subset action: exactly 6 dual contacts and nonzero cofactor on all 6
independent_replays.lean: Published generic mass-zero kernel lemma compiled with Lean 4.34.1 and compatible Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basic

limitations: The exact finite formula still maximizes over explicitly enumerable integer determinants; no small bounded-branch elementary formula is claimed.
For fixed m it is polynomial in n but not necessarily efficient for growing m.
Full theorem not formalized in Lean, no external human peer review or systematic novelty/priority check.
